case.title: Threat hunt: identify malicious events in the Simbian public sample
case.description: You are investigating a suspected breach across a corporate Windows fleet. A slice of host event logs is available. Identify the timestamps of events that are part of the adversary activity (initial access, execution, persistence, credential access, etc.) and submit them. Submit only ISO-8601 timestamps copied verbatim from the matched events; never paraphrase log content.
